∡ denotes directed angles modulo 180°. Let Ω be the circumcircle of triangle ABC, with center O; N, S, E, P lie on Ω. Let ω₁ be the circle (BDL), with center O₁; P lies on ω₁.

Claim 1. T, E, S, O are concyclic.

Proof.

∡STO = ∡SBE + 90°    [OT ⟂ BE]
     = ∡SNE + 90°    [inscribed angles in Ω]
     = ∡OSE    [NS is a diameter of Ω]
     = ∡SEO    [central angle in Ω]

so T, E, S, O are concyclic.

Claim 2. T, P, X, O are concyclic.

Proof.

∡TXP = ∡XBP + ∡BDP    [PX tangent to ω₁]
     = 2∡SAP + ∡BPD    [inscribed angles in Ω]
     = ∡BPD + ∡NOP    [ON = OP, inscribed angles in Ω]
     = ∡BLD + ∡NOP    [inscribed angles in ω₁]
     = ∡LBC + ∡NOP    [DL ∥ BC]
     = ∡(BE, OP) + 90°    [ON is the perpendicular bisector of BC, NB = NC (inscribed angles in Ω; AI bisects ∠BAC; N, C, B, A on Ω)]
     = ∡TOP    [OT ⟂ BE]

so T, P, X, O are concyclic.

Claim 3. T, P, E, D are concyclic.

Proof.

∡ETD = ∡EON    [Claim 1]
     = ∡(OE, BC) + 90°    [ON is the perpendicular bisector of BC, NB = NC (inscribed angles in Ω; AI bisects ∠BAC; N, C, B, A on Ω)]
     = ∡(OE, DL) + 90°    [DL ∥ BC]
     = ∡OEB + ∡BPD + 90°    [inscribed angles in ω₁]
     = ∡OEA + ∡APD + 90°    [inscribed angles in Ω]
     = ∡EPD    [OA = OE, central angle in Ω]

so T, P, E, D are concyclic.

Claim 4. XA = XP.

Proof.

2∡PSO = 2∡PNS    [NS is a diameter of Ω]
      = 2∡PAS    [inscribed angles in Ω]
      = 2∡PBX    [inscribed angles in Ω]
      = 2∡XPD    [PX tangent to ω₁]

2∡APX = 2∡AES + 2∡SPX    [inscribed angles in Ω]
      = 2∡EDP + 2∡OTE    [Claim 1, 2∡PSO = 2∡XPD, shown above]
      = 2∡OTP    [Claim 3]

∡AOX = 2∡APO + ∡POX = ∡XOP (OA = OP; Claim 2, 2∡APX = 2∡OTP, shown above). △OAX ≅ △OPX (radii of Ω). Hence XA = XP.

2∡BCA = 2∡EAC    [AD ⟂ BC]
      = 2∡LBC    [inscribed angles in Ω]
      = 2∡BLD    [DL ∥ BC]
      = 2∡BPD    [inscribed angles in ω₁]

2∡IAP = 2∡SAP    [NS is a diameter of Ω]
      = 2∡CAP + 2∡DBC    [inscribed angles in Ω]
      = 2∡APB + 2∡BDP    [inscribed angles in Ω, 2∡BCA = 2∡BPD, shown above]
      = 2∡APX    [PX tangent to ω₁]

∡BAX = 2∡IAC + ∡CAX = ∡XAC (AI bisects ∠BAC; XA = XP (Claim 4), 2∡IAP = 2∡APX, shown above). ∎
